document:0:618:0.text:
Grezhul has entered the Refinery with Isabella, taking full control of the Soul Forge repairs. Most Syndicate personnel have been sent back to the branch. Only a handful of Graveborn mages remain to assist the military healers in restoring the limbs of Radu.
...
(Several days of routine surveillance reports follow. Nothing unusual.)
...
(The latest report) Grezhul has imprisoned Baba Muriel and her employee Rain inside the Refinery. She has threatened to <style="highlight">use them as the first test subjects for Graveborn conversion</style>.
<style="highlight">Repairs to the Soul Forge are almost complete</style>. It should be operational within half a day. If Bantus succeeds in activating it, your concerns may prove correct—neither the Syndicate nor Novaris will have any leverage left over Bantus.
Please advise whether we should secretly sabotage the repairs or delay them.
document:0:618:0.source_cn:
格瑞泽尔勒已带领伊莎贝拉进入炼化间，全面接管亡灵转化器的修复工作。商会驻派人员中的大部分都被其赶回分部，只留了几位精通魔法的亡灵，协助军医为守亡塔缝合肢体。
……………………
（看起来是很多天的监视记录，没有特殊情况）
……………………
（以下是最新一条汇报）格瑞泽尔勒已将穆婆婆与其手下员工里纳关押至炼化间，并威胁要<style="highlight">将他们作为第一批亡灵转化的实验品</style>。
<style="highlight">亡灵转化器的修复工作已近完成</style>，预计还需半日。若班题斯顺利启动转化器，或许会如您所料：商会和诺珐斯皆会失去对班题斯的制约能力。
是否需要暗中破坏或拖延进度，望您示下。

say:2:1821004001:2.text: Those Bantus lackeys! They're planning to use Baden and Baba Muriel as test subjects!
say:2:1821004001:2.source_cn: 这群班题斯的走狗！竟然要让巴登和穆婆婆当实验品！

say:3:1821004002:0.text: They repaired the Soul Forge too... Damn it. We should've destroyed it for good when we had the chance.
say:3:1821004002:0.source_cn: 他们还想办法修复了机器……该死，当时破坏得不够彻底。

say:4:1821004003:0.text: We only have half a day. As soon as we finish searching the castle, we'll head straight to the Refinery and get Baden out of there!
say:4:1821004003:0.source_cn: 时间只剩下半日。调查完古堡的情况，我们就立刻赶去炼化间...
